title: Qwen 3.6 Plus free on Nous Portal for Hermes Agent
summary: Alibaba's Qwen 3.6 Plus has been made available on Nous Portal and is free for a limited time for use inside Hermes Agent. The model carries a 1 million-token context window and is positioned for long-horizon agentic and web-development workflows. Nous Portal is built on top of OpenRouter and bundles 300+ models with token and paid-tool billing.

research.notes: Nous Portal aggregates 300+ models (built on OpenRouter routing). Qwen 3.6 Plus free for limited promotional period in collaboration with Alibaba Cloud.
